title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 3

blocks.source_text: Brr! Does it feel colder all of a sudden? Minecraft LIVE revealed the first look at our next game drop – and it's frosty. Explore ice caves filled with glittering icicles and ice crystals, plus meet a not-so-chill new hostile mob! This frozen zombie variant is well adapted to colder conditions and can freeze players with its attacks. We're super excited to hear what you think about the new features. Make sure to visit our feedback site at https://aka.ms/mc-gamedrop_winter26 and leave your thoughts!
blocks.translated_text: 嘘！突然感觉冷多了吗？Minecraft LIVE首次展示了我们的下一个游戏更新内容——这次更新的主题是冰霜世界！你将探索充满闪闪发光的冰柱和冰晶的冰洞，同时还会遇到一种全新的、有点“冷酷”的敌对生物！这种冰冻僵尸变异体非常适应寒冷环境，它的攻击能让玩家被冻结！我们非常期待听到你对新内容的反馈，请一定访问我们的反馈网站：https://aka.ms/mc-gamedrop_winter26，留下你的想法吧！

blocks.source_text: Beyond the frozen depths, we've also made a number of improvements to Friends! The Friends list has received a refreshed design, along with new search and sorting options to make it easier to find, organize, and manage your friends. So grab your friends and explore!
blocks.translated_text: 在冰封的深处之外，我们还对“好友”功能进行了多项改进！好友列表的设计焕然一新，新增了搜索和排序选项，让你更容易找到、整理和管理你的好友。快叫上你的朋友们一起探索吧！

blocks.source_text: Added the new Ice Caves Biome
The Ice Cave is a new cave biome that can generate under the colder biomes in the Overworld
blocks.translated_text: 冰洞是一种新的洞穴生物群系，可以在主世界（Overworld）中较寒冷的生物群系下方生成

blocks.source_text: It consists mainly of Packed Ice and Calcite
blocks.translated_text: 冰洞主要由压实的冰（Packed Ice）和方解石（Calcite）组成

blocks.source_text: Icicles generate hanging from the ceiling
blocks.translated_text: 冰柱会从天花板上悬挂下来

blocks.source_text: Large Icicles made of Packed Ice generate on the ground and hanging from the ceiling
blocks.translated_text: 由压实的冰构成的大冰柱会掉在地上，并从天花板上悬挂下来

blocks.source_text: Patches of Snow occasionally generate on the ground
blocks.translated_text: 地面上偶尔会生成雪块

blocks.source_text: Ores generate embedded in pockets of Stone and Deepslate
blocks.translated_text: 矿石会嵌入在石头和深石中生成

blocks.source_text: Glow Lichen does not generate in this biome
blocks.translated_text: 这种生物群落中不会生成发光地衣

blocks.source_text: In addition to the mobs that normally spawn in caves, Strays and Frostbites can also spawn here
blocks.translated_text: 除了通常在洞穴中生成的怪物外，迷途者和霜咬怪物也有可能在这里出现

blocks.source_text: Ice Crystals occasionally generate on the ground
blocks.translated_text: 地面上偶尔会生成冰晶

blocks.source_text: A new crystal-like block similar to Amethyst Clusters
blocks.translated_text: 一种类似于紫水晶簇的新晶体状方块

blocks.source_text: Breaks if the support block is removed
blocks.translated_text: 如果支撑方块被移除，这个方块也会随之破坏

blocks.source_text: It emits light and can be placed in any direction
blocks.translated_text: 这种方块会发光，可以朝任何方向放置

blocks.source_text: A new speleothem-like block similar to Dripstone and Sulfur Spikes
blocks.translated_text: 一种类似钟乳石和硫黄尖锥的新块体

blocks.source_text: Icicles can be found all over the ceiling of ice caves
blocks.translated_text: 冰洞的天花板上到处都可以找到冰柱

blocks.source_text: Can naturally grow up to 5 blocks long when pointing downward
blocks.translated_text: 这种冰柱在向下生长时最长可达5个方块

blocks.source_text: Only grows in areas without nearby light sources and outside the Nether
blocks.translated_text: 仅在没有光源的区域以及下界之外生长

blocks.source_text: It can be placed in any direction and has a base, middle and tip variant
blocks.translated_text: 可以朝任何方向放置，并有底部、中间和顶端的多种形态

blocks.source_text: Damages entities when it falls and deals extra damage to entities that land on it
blocks.translated_text: 掉落时会对实体造成伤害，而落在上面的实体会受到额外伤害

blocks.source_text: Pointed blocks break when exposed to nearby light sources or when placed in the Nether
blocks.translated_text: 暴露在光源附近或放置在下界时，这种冰柱会破裂

blocks.source_text: The Frostbite is a zombie variant that can throw Ice Balls
blocks.translated_text: 冻伤是一种僵尸变种，能够投掷冰球
出现在寒冷/结冰的生物群系中

blocks.source_text: Switches between melee and ranged combat based on target distance and whether they have Ice Balls
blocks.translated_text: 根据目标距离以及目标是否持有冰球，在近战和远程战斗之间切换

blocks.source_text: Melee attacks apply Freezing, while ranged attacks throw Ice Balls
blocks.translated_text: 近战攻击会产生冻结效果，而远程攻击则会投掷冰球

blocks.source_text: Transforms into a Zombie when underwater for long enough
blocks.translated_text: 在水下待太久会变成僵尸

blocks.source_text: Drops Rotten Flesh and Ice Balls
It can stand on top of Powder Snow
It is immune to freezing and does not get slowed by the Freezing effect or Powder Snow
blocks.translated_text: 对冻结效果免疫，也不会受到冻结效果或粉雪的影响而减速

blocks.source_text: Zombies and Husks transform into Frostbites when inside Powder Snow
blocks.translated_text: 僵尸和尸壳在粉雪中会变成冰冻状态

blocks.source_text: The Freezing effect will cause players to shake and eventually deal damage
blocks.translated_text: 冻结效果会使玩家颤抖，并最终造成伤害

blocks.source_text: Causes those affected to slowly become frozen as if in Powdered Snow for its duration
blocks.translated_text: 会使受影响者在效果持续时间内逐渐被冻住，就像处于粉雪中一样

blocks.source_text: Leather Armor protects from freezing, just like with Powder Snow, but will not keep the effect from being applied and will not remove the effect
blocks.translated_text: 皮甲可以防止冻结，就像使用“粉末雪”效果一样；但它不会阻止冻结效果的施加，也不会消除该效果

blocks.source_text: Mobs will take additional damage from Freezing while they are affected by this effect
blocks.translated_text: 受到冻结效果影响的怪物会受到额外的伤害

blocks.source_text: Mobs that are vulnerable to Freezing have a five times multiplier to the damage taken
blocks.translated_text: 容易受到冻结影响的怪物所承受的伤害会增加五倍

blocks.source_text: Lingering Potion, Splash Potion, and Potion of Freezing can be brewed using Ice Balls
blocks.translated_text: “持续效果药水”、“溅射药水”和“冻结药水”可以使用“冰球”来制作

blocks.source_text: Arrows of Freezing can be crafted by placing a Lingering Potion of Freezing in the middle of the crafting table surrounded by eight Arrows
blocks.translated_text: “冻结箭”可以通过在制作台中放入一个“持续效果药水”，然后周围放置八支箭来制作

blocks.source_text: Ice Balls are new projectile used by the Frostbite
blocks.translated_text: 冰球是“冻伤效果”使用的一种新投射物

blocks.source_text: They deal a small amount of damage and have knockback
blocks.translated_text: 冰球会造成少量伤害，并且具有击退效果

blocks.source_text: Deals 4 damage to entities it hits, scaling down with velocity
blocks.translated_text: 冰球会对击中的实体造成4点伤害，伤害量会随着速度的增加而减少

blocks.source_text: Breaks on impact with blocks or entities, creating a particle effect and sound
blocks.translated_text: 与方块或实体碰撞时会发生破碎，同时会产生粒子效果和声音

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对方块、物品和实体进行了微调

blocks.source_text: Snow can now be placed on Packed Ice
blocks.translated_text: 现在可以在压实的冰面上放置雪块

blocks.source_text: Snowballs now apply knockback to players
blocks.translated_text: 雪球现在会对玩家产生击退效果

blocks.source_text: Lightmap visualization is now configurable as lightmap_texture in debug options and appears in the Light group
blocks.translated_text: 光照贴图的可视化设置现在可以在调试选项中配置为“lightmap_texture”，并显示在“Light”组中

blocks.source_text: Its visibility setting is saved with the debug profile
blocks.translated_text: 其可见性设置会随着调试配置文件一起保存

blocks.source_text: It can now be displayed alongside the FPS and network charts
blocks.translated_text: 光照贴图现在可以与FPS和网络图表一起显示

blocks.source_text: The Social Interactions screen has been replaced with the new Other Players screen
blocks.translated_text: 社交互动屏幕已被新的“其他玩家”屏幕取代

blocks.source_text: The "Social Interactions" keybind has been renamed to "Other Players"
blocks.translated_text: “社交互动”快捷键已更名为“其他玩家”

blocks.source_text: The Friends button has received a new icon
blocks.translated_text: 好友按钮更换了新的图标

blocks.source_text: The "Visibility" option has been moved from Online Options into the Friends list
blocks.translated_text: “可见性”选项已从“在线选项”中移至好友列表

blocks.source_text: The icon buttons in the pause menu have been reordered to match the main menu
blocks.translated_text: 暂停菜单中的图标按钮顺序已调整以匹配主菜单的布局

blocks.source_text: Updated the design of the Friends list
blocks.translated_text: 好友列表的设计已更新

blocks.source_text: In the Friends tab, the profile name text box used for sending requests also functions as a search box
blocks.translated_text: 在好友选项卡中，用于发送请求的个人资料名称输入框同时也可用作搜索框

blocks.source_text: In the requests tab, a search box appears at the top if you have 15 or more requests
blocks.translated_text: 在请求选项卡中，如果你有15条或更多请求，顶部会出现一个搜索框

blocks.source_text: Sort modes can be cycled through by pressing the new sort button
blocks.translated_text: 通过点击新的排序按钮可以循环切换排序方式

blocks.source_text: Sort by who's online - friends who are listed as online appear at the top of the list
blocks.translated_text: 按在线状态排序——显示为在线的朋友会出现在列表顶部

blocks.source_text: Sort by alphabetical order - friends are sorted according to the alphabetical order of their names
blocks.translated_text: 按字母顺序排序——朋友会根据名字的字母顺序排列

blocks.source_text: Clicking on a player's icon in the Friends list now opens their Player Options
blocks.translated_text: 现在点击好友列表中的玩家图标会打开他们的玩家设置

blocks.source_text: This functionality is now accessible through Player Options instead
blocks.translated_text: 此功能现在可以通过玩家设置来访问

blocks.source_text: Player Options is a new screen accessible through both the Friends list and Other Players.
blocks.translated_text: 玩家设置是一个新的界面，既可以通过好友列表也可以通过“其他玩家”入口访问

blocks.source_text: It contains per-player social actions previously spread across the Friends list and Social Interactions
blocks.translated_text: 它包含了之前分散在好友列表和社交互动中的个性化操作功能

blocks.source_text: Sending or canceling a friend request
Accepting or declining a friend request
Muting a player hides their chat messages until the next time you start the game
blocks.translated_text: 静音玩家后，他们的聊天消息将不会显示，直到你下次开始游戏

blocks.source_text: Blocking players is managed through Other Players
blocks.translated_text: -blocking玩家的功能通过“其他玩家”界面进行管理

blocks.source_text: Other Players is a new menu which has been added to replace Social Interactions.
blocks.translated_text: “其他玩家”是一个新添加的菜单，用于替代“社交互动”界面

blocks.source_text: Other Players is only available when playing on a world open to multiplayer
blocks.translated_text: “其他玩家”仅在允许多人玩的世界中可用

blocks.source_text: Playing in singleplayer worlds open to LAN
blocks.translated_text: 在局域网（LAN）可访问的单人游戏世界中游玩
在 Realms 服务器上游玩

blocks.source_text: It can be opened by pressing the "Other Players" icon button in the pause menu
blocks.translated_text: 可以通过暂停菜单中的“其他玩家”图标按钮打开该列表

blocks.source_text: It can also be opened from in-game using the "Other Players" key ('P' by default)
blocks.translated_text: 也可以通过游戏内的“其他玩家”键（默认为‘P’）打开该列表

blocks.source_text: It lists the players currently online in the world you are in
blocks.translated_text: 该列表会显示你当前所在游戏世界中在线的玩家

blocks.source_text: It lists players who are not online anymore, but may still be of interest:
blocks.translated_text: 该列表还会显示已离线但可能仍具兴趣的玩家

blocks.source_text: Players who were just online but left
blocks.translated_text: 刚刚上线后又离开的玩家

blocks.source_text: Players who recently sent messages in the chat
blocks.translated_text: 最近在聊天中发送过消息的玩家

blocks.source_text: Clicking on a player's icon in the list opens their Player Options
blocks.translated_text: 点击列表中的玩家图标可以打开他们的玩家设置（Player Options）

blocks.source_text: Redesigned the save/discard draft confirmation screen
blocks.translated_text: 重新设计了保存/丢弃草稿确认界面

blocks.source_text: Player reports saved as drafts no longer prompt you to discard them upon exiting a world if they can be continued later
blocks.translated_text: 如果玩家报告可以稍后继续，那么保存为草稿的玩家报告在退出游戏时不会再提示你丢弃它们

blocks.source_text: Chat reports can never be continued
blocks.translated_text: 聊天报告无法继续发送

blocks.source_text: Name reports can be continued if the reported player is in your Friends list
blocks.translated_text: 如果被举报的玩家在你的好友列表中，名字报告可以继续发送

blocks.source_text: Skin reports can be continued if the reported player is in your Friends list
blocks.translated_text: 如果被举报的玩家在你的好友列表中，皮肤报告可以继续发送

blocks.source_text: Pressing "Quit Game" in the main menu will now give a warning if you have an unsent draft report that would be lost
blocks.translated_text: 现在，在主菜单中点击“退出游戏”（Quit Game）时会弹出警告，提醒你有未发送的草稿报告可能会丢失

blocks.source_text: A new chunk_section_status shows the rendering status of chunks around you. This will impact performance at high view distances.
blocks.translated_text: 新的“chunk_section_status”功能显示了你周围块的渲染状态。这可能会影响高视野距离下的游戏性能

blocks.source_text: The chunk load overlay has been split off from visualize_chunks_on_server and into a new chunk_load_status
blocks.translated_text: 区块加载提示界面已从 `visualize_chunks_on_server` 中分离出来，并重新命名为 `chunk_load_status`

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 123.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本现为您看到的 123.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 100.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本现为您看到的 100.0
数据包版本范围为 122.0 至 123.0

blocks.source_text: Added placement_options - a field that contains various settings for the placement of the Speleothem cluster:
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 `placement_options` 字段——该字段用于设置洞穴群（Speleothem cluster）的放置参数。

blocks.source_text: placement_mode - represented by an enum that is one of floor_and_ceiling , floor_only , ceiling_only
blocks.translated_text: placement_mode - 由一个枚举表示，可选值包含 floor_and_ceiling、floor_only 和 ceiling_only

blocks.source_text: base_block_transformer - sets a state on the base block of the Speleothem block
blocks.translated_text: base_block_transformer - 用于设置 Speleothem 块的基础块的状态

blocks.source_text: none - the regular base block state used in Sulfur Spikes and Dripstone Spikes
blocks.translated_text: none - 在硫黄尖锥（Sulfur Spikes）和滴石尖锥（Dripstone Spikes）中使用的常规基础块状态

blocks.source_text: set_attached - the state of the base block of the Icicle when it is attached to a surface
blocks.translated_text: set Attached - 冰柱（Icicle）附着在表面时的状态

blocks.source_text: allow_water_placement - boolean indicating whether the Speleothem can be placed in water or not
blocks.translated_text: allow_water-placement - 布尔值，表示 Speleothem 块是否可以放置在水中

blocks.source_text: Added field base_block - Block State Provider, the block to build the large dripstone out of
blocks.translated_text: 新增字段 `base_block` — 用于指定构建大型滴石的方块类型
新增了以下矿石生成规则
冰穴中的中等大小钻石矿石
冰穴中的大型钻石矿石
埋藏在地下的冰穴钻石矿石
埋藏在地下的冰穴青金石矿石
冰穴中的下层红石矿石
冰穴中的安山岩矿石（上层）
冰穴中的安山岩矿石（下层）
冰穴中的闪长岩矿石（上层）
冰穴中的闪长岩矿石（下层）

blocks.source_text: These are all identical to their non-ice-cave counterparts, only that they place a patch of stone or deepslate (depending on y-level) before placing the ore itself
blocks.translated_text: 这些矿石与非冰穴中的对应矿石完全相同，只不过在放置矿石之前会先放置一块石头或深石板（具体取决于 y 坐标）

blocks.source_text: They can replace Ice and Calcite as well
blocks.translated_text: 它们也可以替代冰矿石和方解石矿石

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:block_sound_set registry containing definitions for sounds produced by different categories of blocks.
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 `minecraft:block_sound_set` 注册表，其中包含了不同类别方块产生的声音的定义。
格式：一个包含以下字段的对象：

blocks.source_text: volume - a float between 0.00001 and 10.0 , the relative volume at which all sounds will be played
blocks.translated_text: `volume` – 一个介于 0.00001 和 10.0 之间的浮点数，表示所有声音的播放响度；如果未指定，则默认为 1.0

blocks.source_text: pitch - a float between 0.00001 and 2.0 , the relative pitch at which all sounds will be played
blocks.translated_text: `pitch` – 一个介于 0.00001 和 2.0 之间的浮点数，表示所有声音的播放音调；如果未指定，则默认为 1.0

blocks.source_text: break_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played when the block gets broken
blocks.translated_text: `break_sound` – 声音事件，方块被破坏时播放的声音

blocks.source_text: step_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played when an entity walks on top of the block
blocks.translated_text: `step_sound` – 声音事件，实体站在方块上时播放的声音

blocks.source_text: place_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played when the block gets placed
blocks.translated_text: `place_sound` – 声音事件，放置方块时播放的声音

blocks.source_text: hit_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played while the block is being destroyed
blocks.translated_text: hit_sound - 声音事件：在方块被破坏时播放的声音

blocks.source_text: fall_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played when an entity falls onto the block
blocks.translated_text: fall_sound - 声音事件：当实体落在方块上时播放的声音
所有声音字段都是可选的

blocks.source_text: Added block tag ice_cave_ore_replaceables to describe all blocks which are allowed to be replaced by ores within Ice Caves (in addition to stone_ore_replaceables , height_specific_ore_replaceables and deepslate_ore_replaceables )
blocks.translated_text: 新增了方块标签 `ice_cave_ore_replaceables`，用于描述在冰穴中可以被矿石替换的所有方块（除了 `stone_ore_replaceables`、`height_specific_ore_replaceables` 和 `deepslate_ore_replaceables`）

blocks.source_text: Added block tag melts_icicle_above to describe all blocks causing Icicles directly above to melt
blocks.translated_text: 新增了方块标签 `melts_icicle_above`，用于描述会导致上方冰柱融化的所有方块

blocks.source_text: Added block tag large_icicle_replaceable to describe all blocks which are allowed to be replaced by Large Icicles within the Ice Caves biome
blocks.translated_text: 新增了方块标签 `large_icicle_replaceable`，用于描述在冰穴生物群系中可以被大冰柱替换的所有方块

blocks.source_text: Added several block tags to affect how mobs pathfind:
blocks.translated_text: 新增了几个方块标签，以影响怪物的路径寻找行为

blocks.source_text: #pathfinding/avoid_in_air - blocks to be avoided while flying, either due to danger our potential to get stuck
blocks.translated_text: #pathfinding/avoid_in_air - 飞行时需要避免的方块，因为这些方块可能存在危险或导致玩家卡住

blocks.source_text: #pathfinding/damage_cautious - blocks that will damage entities that walk through them, but are not considered dangerous enough to avoid entirely
blocks.translated_text: #pathfinding/damage_cautious - 会伤害通过的实体的方块，但危险程度不足以完全避免

blocks.source_text: #pathfinding/damaging - blocks that will damage entities that walk through them
blocks.translated_text: #pathfinding/damaging - 会伤害通过的实体的方块

blocks.source_text: #pathfinding/drop_down - blocks that can be dropped down through
#pathfinding/open - blocks that are considered completely open to walk through
blocks.translated_text: #pathfinding/open - 可以完全通过的开放方块

blocks.source_text: #pathfinding/powder_snow - blocks that are considered powder snow
#pathfinding/sticky - blocks that are considered sticky, causing slowed movement and inability to jump
blocks.translated_text: #pathfinding/sticky - 有粘性的方块，会导致移动缓慢且无法跳跃

blocks.source_text: Added #frostbite_preferred_weapons for items picked up and used by the Frostbite
blocks.translated_text: 为 Frostbite 流派拾取并使用的物品添加了 #frostbite_preferred_weapons 标签

blocks.source_text: Added #knocks_back_players_even_with_zero_damage for items which shall apply knockback even if they do 0 damage
blocks.translated_text: 为那些即使造成 0 点伤害也会产生击退效果的物品添加了 #knocks_back_players_even_with_zero_damage 标签

Brr! Does it feel colder all of a sudden? Minecraft LIVE revealed the first look at our next game drop – and it's frosty. Explore ice caves filled with glittering icicles and ice crystals, plus meet a not-so-chill new hostile mob! This frozen zombie variant is well adapted to colder conditions and can freeze players with its attacks. We're super excited to hear what you think about the new features. Make sure to visit our feedback site at https://aka.ms/mc-gamedrop_winter26 and leave your thoughts!

Beyond the frozen depths, we've also made a number of improvements to Friends! The Friends list has received a refreshed design, along with new search and sorting options to make it easier to find, organize, and manage your friends. So grab your friends and explore!

Happy ice-caving!

New Features

Added the new Ice Caves Biome

Added Ice Crystals

Added Icicles

Added the Frostbite mob

Added the Freezing mob effect

Added the Ice Ball

Ice Caves

The Ice Cave is a new cave biome that can generate under the colder biomes in the Overworld

It consists mainly of Packed Ice and Calcite

Icicles generate hanging from the ceiling

Large Icicles made of Packed Ice generate on the ground and hanging from the ceiling

Patches of Snow occasionally generate on the ground

Ores generate embedded in pockets of Stone and Deepslate

Glow Lichen does not generate in this biome

In addition to the mobs that normally spawn in caves, Strays and Frostbites can also spawn here

Ice Crystals occasionally generate on the ground

Ice Crystal

A new crystal-like block similar to Amethyst Clusters

Breaks if the support block is removed

It emits light and can be placed in any direction

Icicle

A new speleothem-like block similar to Dripstone and Sulfur Spikes

Icicles can be found all over the ceiling of ice caves

Can naturally grow up to 5 blocks long when pointing downward

Only grows in areas without nearby light sources and outside the Nether

It can be placed in any direction and has a base, middle and tip variant

Damages entities when it falls and deals extra damage to entities that land on it

Pointed blocks break when exposed to nearby light sources or when placed in the Nether

Frostbite

The Frostbite is a zombie variant that can throw Ice Balls

Spawns in cold/icy biomes

Switches between melee and ranged combat based on target distance and whether they have Ice Balls

Melee attacks apply Freezing, while ranged attacks throw Ice Balls

Transforms into a Zombie when underwater for long enough

Drops Rotten Flesh and Ice Balls

It can stand on top of Powder Snow

It is immune to freezing and does not get slowed by the Freezing effect or Powder Snow

Zombies and Husks transform into Frostbites when inside Powder Snow

Freezing Mob Effect

The Freezing effect will cause players to shake and eventually deal damage

Causes those affected to slowly become frozen as if in Powdered Snow for its duration

Leather Armor protects from freezing, just like with Powder Snow, but will not keep the effect from being applied and will not remove the effect

Mobs will take additional damage from Freezing while they are affected by this effect

Mobs that are vulnerable to Freezing have a five times multiplier to the damage taken

Lingering Potion, Splash Potion, and Potion of Freezing can be brewed using Ice Balls

Arrows of Freezing can be crafted by placing a Lingering Potion of Freezing in the middle of the crafting table surrounded by eight Arrows

Ice Ball

Ice Balls are new projectile used by the Frostbite

They deal a small amount of damage and have knockback

Deals 4 damage to entities it hits, scaling down with velocity

Breaks on impact with blocks or entities, creating a particle effect and sound

Changes

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Snow can now be placed on Packed Ice

Snowballs now apply knockback to players

UI

Lightmap visualization is now configurable as lightmap_texture in debug options and appears in the Light group

Its visibility setting is saved with the debug profile

It can now be displayed alongside the FPS and network charts

The Social Interactions screen has been replaced with the new Other Players screen

The "Social Interactions" keybind has been renamed to "Other Players"

The Friends button has received a new icon

The "Visibility" option has been moved from Online Options into the Friends list

The icon buttons in the pause menu have been reordered to match the main menu

Friends

Updated the design of the Friends list

Added searching

In the Friends tab, the profile name text box used for sending requests also functions as a search box

In the requests tab, a search box appears at the top if you have 15 or more requests

Added sorting

Sort modes can be cycled through by pressing the new sort button

The current sort modes are:

Sort by who's online - friends who are listed as online appear at the top of the list

Sort by alphabetical order - friends are sorted according to the alphabetical order of their names

Clicking on a player's icon in the Friends list now opens their Player Options

Removed "Remove Friend" button

This functionality is now accessible through Player Options instead

Player Options

Player Options is a new screen accessible through both the Friends list and Other Players.

It contains per-player social actions previously spread across the Friends list and Social Interactions

These actions are:

Sending or canceling a friend request

Accepting or declining a friend request

Muting a player

Reporting a player

Muting a player hides their chat messages until the next time you start the game

Blocking players is managed through Other Players

Other Players

Other Players is a new menu which has been added to replace Social Interactions.

Other Players is only available when playing on a world open to multiplayer

This includes:

Playing in singleplayer worlds open to LAN

Playing on dedicated servers

Playing on Realms

It can be opened by pressing the "Other Players" icon button in the pause menu

It can also be opened from in-game using the "Other Players" key ('P' by default)

It lists the players currently online in the world you are in

It lists players who are not online anymore, but may still be of interest:

Players who were just online but left

Players who recently sent messages in the chat

Clicking on a player's icon in the list opens their Player Options

Player Reporting

Redesigned the save/discard draft confirmation screen

Player reports saved as drafts no longer prompt you to discard them upon exiting a world if they can be continued later

Chat reports can never be continued

Name reports can be continued if the reported player is in your Friends list

Skin reports can be continued if the reported player is in your Friends list

Pressing "Quit Game" in the main menu will now give a warning if you have an unsent draft report that would be lost

Debug Overlay

A new chunk_section_status shows the rendering status of chunks around you. This will impact performance at high view distances.

The chunk load overlay has been split off from visualize_chunks_on_server and into a new chunk_load_status

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 123.0

The Resource Pack version is now 100.0

Data Pack Versions 122.0 through 123.0

World Generation

Features

Changed

minecraft:speleothem_cluster

Added placement_options - a field that contains various settings for the placement of the Speleothem cluster:

placement_mode - represented by an enum that is one of floor_and_ceiling , floor_only , ceiling_only

base_block_transformer - sets a state on the base block of the Speleothem block

none - the regular base block state used in Sulfur Spikes and Dripstone Spikes

set_attached - the state of the base block of the Icicle when it is attached to a surface

allow_water_placement - boolean indicating whether the Speleothem can be placed in water or not

ice_cave_ore_gravel

These are all identical to their non-ice-cave counterparts, only that they place a patch of stone or deepslate (depending on y-level) before placing the ore itself

They can replace Ice and Calcite as well

Block Sound Sets

Added minecraft:block_sound_set registry containing definitions for sounds produced by different categories of blocks.

Format: object with fields:

volume - a float between 0.00001 and 10.0 , the relative volume at which all sounds will be played

If not present, defaults to 1.0

pitch - a float between 0.00001 and 2.0 , the relative pitch at which all sounds will be played

If not present, defaults to 1.0

break_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played when the block gets broken

step_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played when an entity walks on top of the block

place_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played when the block gets placed

hit_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played while the block is being destroyed

fall_sound - Sound Event, the sound that will be played when an entity falls onto the block

All sound fields are optional

Tags

Block Tags

Added block tag ice_cave_ore_replaceables to describe all blocks which are allowed to be replaced by ores within Ice Caves (in addition to stone_ore_replaceables , height_specific_ore_replaceables and deepslate_ore_replaceables )

Added block tag melts_icicle_above to describe all blocks causing Icicles directly above to melt

Added block tag large_icicle_replaceable to describe all blocks which are allowed to be replaced by Large Icicles within the Ice Caves biome

Added several block tags to affect how mobs pathfind:

#pathfinding/avoid_in_air - blocks to be avoided while flying, either due to danger our potential to get stuck

#pathfinding/damage_cautious - blocks that will damage entities that walk through them, but are not considered dangerous enough to avoid entirely

#pathfinding/damaging - blocks that will damage entities that walk through them

#pathfinding/drop_down - blocks that can be dropped down through

#pathfinding/leaves - blocks that are considered leaves

#pathfinding/open - blocks that are considered completely open to walk through

#pathfinding/powder_snow - blocks that are considered powder snow

#pathfinding/rails - blocks that are considered rails

#pathfinding/sticky - blocks that are considered sticky, causing slowed movement and inability to jump

Item Tags

Added #frostbite_preferred_weapons for items picked up and used by the Frostbite

Added #knocks_back_players_even_with_zero_damage for items which shall apply knockback even if they do 0 damage

Added #sheep_wool_dyes - items that can be used to dye a Sheep's wool

The color will be taken from the minecraft:dye component of the used item stack

Biome Tags

Added #spawns_strays_without_powder_snow to describe all biomes which allow the spawning of strays without requiring powder snow on the surface above them

Block Sound Set Tags

Added #sounds_wooden - block sound sets which when stepped on cause Horses to produce a galloping sound

Particles

Removed particle type minecraft:item_snowball

Added minecraft:freezing

Emitted by Entities which are affected by the Freezing mob effect

冰洞

冰洞是一种新的洞穴生物群系，可以在主世界（Overworld）中较寒冷的生物群系下方生成

冰洞主要由压实的冰（Packed Ice）和方解石（Calcite）组成

冰柱会从天花板上悬挂下来

由压实的冰构成的大冰柱会掉在地上，并从天花板上悬挂下来

地面上偶尔会生成雪块

矿石会嵌入在石头和深石中生成

这种生物群落中不会生成发光地衣

除了通常在洞穴中生成的怪物外，迷途者和霜咬怪物也有可能在这里出现

地面上偶尔会生成冰晶

冰晶

一种类似于紫水晶簇的新晶体状方块

如果支撑方块被移除，这个方块也会随之破坏

这种方块会发光，可以朝任何方向放置

冰柱

一种类似钟乳石和硫黄尖锥的新块体

冰洞的天花板上到处都可以找到冰柱

仅在没有光源的区域以及下界之外生长

可以朝任何方向放置，并有底部、中间和顶端的多种形态

掉落时会对实体造成伤害，而落在上面的实体会受到额外伤害

暴露在光源附近或放置在下界时，这种冰柱会破裂

冻伤

冻伤是一种僵尸变种，能够投掷冰球

出现在寒冷/结冰的生物群系中

在水下待太久会变成僵尸

会掉落腐肉和冰球

能够站在粉雪上

对冻结效果免疫，也不会受到冻结效果或粉雪的影响而减速
